-   **IUCN:** Least Concern
-   **Rarity note:** Common throughout Florida, found in areas with sparse grass or low vegetation.

## Natural history notes

A tiny ground-dwelling dove characterized by its sandy brown coloration, scaled-looking breast and neck, short tail, and small dark bill. In Florida, it is found in open sandy habitats, scrub, pine flatwoods, prairies, roadsides, lawns, agricultural edges, and coastal areas with sparse grasses or low vegetation. It feeds mainly on small seeds, usually foraging on the ground in pairs or small groups, and often flies up with a soft whirring sound when disturbed.
